**Access boundary:** Restricted operator authority required.

Source candidate with isolated tests; migration, explicit access installation and actual saved-submission host cases remain separate qualification.

**Surfaces:** Authorized private operator setup; existing web, REST, MCP and native preparation/tracking retain their current account and document guards.

[Read the engineering guide](/engineering/provider-maintenance/) · [All features](/features/)

## Capabilities

<ol>
<li id="feature-ecf8d116d2b3">One-time explicit operator registration binds the exact restricted reviewer, sole current administrator membership, archived review tariff and original authority without periodic expiry</li>
<li id="feature-dc4c8c16c627">Current database views recheck exact tenant/identity/sender/recipient, qualified source relationships, disabled fax channel and absence of expert policy</li>
<li id="feature-771975ee540a">New immutable quotes bind review_access_id, retain the 900-second lifetime, seven-page limit and EUR2 ceiling, and explicitly identify archived_review_reference pricing</li>
<li id="feature-e2deba582033">Irreversible revocation or guard drift closes preparation and quote validation without temporary-authority fallback; historical rows and fingerprints remain unchanged</li>
<li id="feature-1a10edd88af5">No approval, acceptance, sending, reservation, provider attempt, outbox, media grant or financial settlement is available; the independent prepare_only account restriction remains in force</li>
<li id="feature-0d37bea083f8">Compatible bounded old-schema reads and null-omitting historical hashes permit a runtime-first rollout before schema; private planning and digest-bound atomic application grant no account/password/Auth0 change or public API</li>
</ol>
